tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The ground behind every screen: a pale warm off-white in light, near-black in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the composer and the side panel, lifted from `bg` by `shadow-raised`.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Soft fills: secondary buttons, hovered and selected rows, the student's own chat messages, answered states.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus and dialogs. Always paired with `shadow-overlay`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only; never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of inputs, secondary buttons and chips (3:1 on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-raised`).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-overlay`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, helper copy, inactive tabs. Reads on every surface and soft fill.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, timestamps, disabled-looking but still legible text (4.5:1 on all surfaces).

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an `ink` fill: the active segment of SegmentedTabs, the inverse pill.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one primary button per screen.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of `primary` fills.

tokens.name: primary-active
tokens.usage: Pressed state of `primary` fills.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary`, `primary-hover`, `primary-active`.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Links, the current nav item, focus.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Behind the current nav item, citations and the current question.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: Star gold: the mastery target marker, 'Recommended' badges, current path node glow. Accent only, never body text in light.

tokens.name: star-text
tokens.usage: Gold text: 'Recommended' labels, minor-gap severity, general-knowledge warnings. On surfaces and `star-soft`.

tokens.name: on-star
tokens.usage: Text on a `star` fill (the rare solid gold badge).

tokens.name: star-soft
tokens.usage: Background of recommended badges and general-knowledge notices.

tokens.name: mastery
tokens.usage: Right answers and what the student knows.

tokens.name: mastery-text
tokens.usage: Text for 'correct', 'mastered' and on-track counts, on surfaces and `mastery-soft`.

tokens.name: mastery-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a correct quiz option and the mastered counter.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Wrong answers, severe gaps, destructive actions. Always with an icon or word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a wrong quiz option and severe-gap rows; `danger` text reads on it.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus outline on every control.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals, the whiteboard and the lesson wizard.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Alias: warnings share the star gold text (engine not signed in, stale topic).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Alias: informational text and icons.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Panels inside a card, such as a formula or a graph.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Right answers in quizzes and results.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Behind a right answer.

tokens.name: ring-prep
tokens.usage: The Preparazione ring and its legend dot only.

tokens.name: ring-path
tokens.usage: The Percorso ring and its legend dot only.

tokens.name: ring-today
tokens.usage: The Oggi ring and its legend dot only.

tokens.name: ring-track
tokens.usage: The empty part of each exam ring.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The one big number of a view: preparation level, quiz score.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Home greeting and empty-state headline. Once per screen.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Plan title in the plan header, wizard step titles.

styles.name: title-2
styles.sample: La tua preparazione negli ultimi 14 giorni

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Card titles, topic names, modal titles.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: Il primo principio della termodinamica afferma che l'energia di un sistema isolato si conserva.
styles.usage: Tutor replies, smart-text lessons, flashcard faces. Max width 68ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Carica appunti, slide o uno smartbook per costruire il percorso.
styles.usage: Default UI text: lists, forms, descriptions.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: UPPERCASE: segmented tabs, section eyebrows, the header doors. Always uppercase, never sentence text.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Lowercase data pills: target, model ids, dates on charts, counts.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks and runnable Python cells.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row, chip padding-y.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control inner padding-x (small), list row gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact), grid gutter between tiles.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Control padding-x (medium/large buttons).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between stacked cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top padding of a page below the header.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Vertical step between study-path nodes.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Rows inside a card, icon buttons, nav items, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Buttons, text fields, question numbers, formula keys.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels inside a card: a formula, a graph.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and the composer.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The side panel, the quiz sheet, the Adesso card, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Legacy: screens not yet moved to the 0.5 look. Don't use in new UI.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Legacy: screens not yet moved to the 0.5 look. New UI uses circles only for the path markers, the rings and their legend dots.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, chips, header icon buttons.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button, input and segmented height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary call to action (Continua), wizard inputs.

tokens.name: path-node
tokens.usage: Study-path node square.

tokens.name: content-width
tokens.usage: Max width of the centred content column (chat, plan, progress).

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus and dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: The one soft shadow that lifts cards, the composer and the side panel.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting rows and small controls that need a hint of an edge.

tokens.name: glow-star
tokens.usage: Only the CURRENT study-path node: the student's position on the map.
